notes: The farm, the road and the courtyard sit on Scene 2's frame, +x east and +y north in metres from the lamp niche; the run past the village gate sits on Scene 6A's village_gate frame, whose arch and elders' bench replace eliab_valley's drawing of them.
The low sun stands at 180° through the whole dusk, between Scene 12's 175° and the farm's 195°, so Eliab runs east with it at his back and comes at his son out of it.
Eliab lights the lamp from the yard face of the niche with flint and striker as in Scene 6B, then steps into the gateway, where the figure shows about 1.1 km down the road below the village.
The evening orders go across the yard by hand and nod, because the screenplay writes them as action; every spoken word in the scene is the screenplay's own.

W01 to W03 is one take that ends at a run behind him down the road under the teacher's voice; W04 follows him down the hill path past the rising elders and stops at its foot by choice while he runs on.

The road comes into the meeting point from 152°, so the runner comes on in the glare just right of the sun and swings straight out of it for his last five metres, where the flare stitch falls, W06 with references off and W07 with Eliab's on.

W07 receives the meeting at Asher's left shoulder and turns round them until his arms come up, so the embrace completes inside one window; the name, the confession and the three orders continue in place within two metres.
Micah takes the signet as he turns back, Dan and Shallum run back up the road one order apart, and Miriam stays at Asher's side; the cut to night folds the walk home.
The courtyard plays at the new-lit yard fire before the house door, Scene 14's dance ring, with the gate lamp and the neighbours' lamps far across the yard; the robe's wool is its one stitch.
Amos is away at the far field for the whole scene, as Scene 15 has him; people stand at each plan's start, so slabs and path ends mark where Asher stops dead and where the embrace lands.
